exposure: Before and after implementation of mandatory shoulder dystocia simulation training
cohort: 8930 vaginal deliveries over a 6-year period, including deliveries before and after the implementation of a mandatory shoulder dystocia simulation curriculum
finding: Despite no significant improvements observed in maternal or neonatal outcomes, the frequency of reported shoulder dystocia doubled after the implementation of a mandatory shoulder dystocia simulation curriculum, suggesting increased provider awareness and intervention.
mod_finding: The overall frequency of shoulder dystocia reportedly doubled after training despite stable operative vaginal delivery and caesarean delivery rates.
